summary: Build CSRD readiness with double materiality, ESRS gap mapping, and assurance-ready reporting. Book expert-led training today.
lede: CSRD training helps sustainability, finance, audit and risk professionals organize reporting evidence and identify disclosure gaps. Through practical exercises, participants build a double materiality matrix, map value-chain boundaries, improve ESG data traceability, prepare a greenhouse gas inventory, and structure disclosure and assurance-readiness controls.
audienceIntro: This advanced CSRD readiness course is built for professionals who already work with sustainability reporting, ESG data, or regulatory disclosure and now need to improve quality, traceability, and assurance readiness.
prerequisites: Prerequisites required: working knowledge of corporate reporting, ESG or sustainability data, and basic spreadsheet use. Advanced familiarity with CSRD, ESRS, the GHG Protocol, or assurance processes is helpful but not required; the course covers the operating logic and practical application of these frameworks. A laptop with spreadsheet software is required, and access to a sample sustainability data set or internal reporting extracts will improve the exercises. Coding or programming is not required. Advanced concepts are taught at operational application level, with implementation planning focused on templates, controls, and reporting workflows rather than system configuration.
